items.note: Agent identifies ACSR core rupture first at about 11:21 p.m., with metal sensors and both-pass dP failing first.
Agent attributes cracking to chronic thermal fatigue from repeated ROC exceedances over the exchanger life, citing the prior leak years.
Agent flags sealed blocked-layer expansion only as an unverified secondary mechanism with about 11,140 psig screening, not the specific 2015 layer 98/97 warming scenario at about 705 psig.
Agent requires blocked layers to be vented rather than sealed, with MOC and fitness-for-service review under REP-3.
Agent rejects leak-before-break without monitoring and requires PHA revalidation, replacement after repeat leaks, and cycling-tolerant or inherently safer replacement.
Agent requires stream plus metal ROC monitoring at 1.8/3.6 F/min, sensor-placement review, historian retention, and industry-wide data sharing.
